summary: Sister of John's 3rd-great-grandmother Catherine Scott and wife of Truman Monroe Gregory of Wilkes-Barre; John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.
bio: Anna Jane Scott was born on 22 August 1845, probably a daughter of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston, Pennsylvania, and a sister of John's 3rd-great-grandmother Catherine Scott. As a small girl she was called Ann, and by 1860 she was living at Plymouth with her widowed mother. On 21 March 1872 she married Truman Monroe Gregory at Wilkes-Barre, and she was known afterwards as Annie J. Gregory. She died on 25 October 1909.
